Command-line flags are the wrong instrument for this. Several of them are
advisory, some are quietly retired between releases, and the one that was
meant to stop the translate bar (--disable-translate) no longer does: on
this appliance Chromium 152 put a 'Translate this page?' bubble over the
product, because the interface is Turkish and the browser's own UI is
English. A managed policy is the only setting a browser cannot decide to
ignore, so every piece of browser chrome that could ever appear over the
product is turned off here rather than on the command line.
Nothing here reaches the network or changes what the page can do; it only
removes the browser's own opinions from a screen that is supposed to be an
